character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: copper-red hair in a short layered bob, warm hazel eyes, a calm, observant face; a resilient field naturalist and wanderer, wearing a practical layered field outfit with a distinctive scarf, fitted jacket, and durable boots with snow white accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in narrow ridge trail, snow slope in wind, cloud sea at sunrise; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with rock grey, snow white, alpenglow pink, sky blue; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by long upward tilt along a steep ridge, wide shot with tiny trail markers for scale, low shot of a snowy trail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
